notes.title: Full Game Rework - New Graphics, New Animations, New Gameplay.
notes.content:
[u]Full Game Rework[/u] - New Graphics, New Animations, New Gameplay.
I have been working on updates daily for about 2 months now here is the latest changes:

[b]SCROLL TO THE BOTTOM FOR MORE GAMEPLAY SCREENSHOTS[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28014809/9fc207dca27d9328071348a0c97e1b287c0a75ee.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28014809/dbc6c867d184672fbdf66adcc8ac94b4c7dbeb15.jpg[/img]

[list]
[*] Added Multiple Hidden Easter Eggs, Secret Weapons, and more.
[*] Finished the first level for the main game
[*] Updated main menu and settings
[*] New Foliage/Landscape Graphics Overhaul for main game first level
[*] Updated Multiplayer connections, you can now join through steam no problem
[*] Added 2 new assault rifles and 2 pistols
[*] Added feature when you burn an altar it stuns and damages each monster
[*] Added counter at the top right for how many altars are left/burned
[*] Made controls at start pop up and stay longer
[*] Updated the start of the map and added a buyable vendor where you can buy equipment
[*] New Doors in the works, some already placed around the map with keys to find
[*] New monsters added, now there is a total of 2-4 monsters with chances to spawn as well.
[*] Destroy all the power towers to stop monsters from spawning
[*] Added Voice Dialogue In A Radio at the Start of the Map Haunted House. (Voice is by Sebastion Born from our Ravesta Games Discord) *We need more voices if anyone is interested feel free to join discord!
[*] Fixes to Broken Doors not working
[*] Fixes to any issues regarding movement with stamina, its now fixed.
[*] Improved networking with lag compensation for P2P Networking on Steam for a smoother experience.
[*] Adjustments to overall Level of Detail
[*] Optimized by removing unnecessary objects in certain places and combining more well lit scenes without the cost of the framerate
[*] 2 new areas were created with the existing space without costing more usage or lag.
[*] Adjustments made to the AI Navigation to improve AI and the map
[*] Added 2 new keys, and 2 new key CARDS that are in the level and all thoroughly tested to verify 100% success rate
[*] Fixed Pistol ammo size (still no ammo spawns just that pistol wtih that ammo will add more weapons later on)
[*] Updated Note at the start of haunted house to make it more clear as what to do objective wise.
[*] Fixed LOUD Monster Noises.
[*] Added small Jumpscare by the house
[*] Added New Game Logo to Main Menu
[*] Added new effects to altors burning
[*] Added new fog effects and improved over visual lighting with fog now runs better
[*] Improved Issues with Monster Ai
[*] Fixed to fat to fit inside the barn door lol
[*] Removed compass for now and just left minimap
[*] New Lobby UI
[*] Lobby Improvements In-Game
[*] Character Movement Speed Slightly Increased
[*] Monster AI sounds updated
[*] New Monster AI Animations
[*] New Main Menu
[*] New Pause Menu
[*] New Settings Menu
[*] Updated Code to Door
[*] Overall Visual Improvements to Lighting/Weather
[*] Enabled New Night Time Lighting and Sky Sphere
[*] Opened up spawn area x2 sizes
[*] Opened up grave yard area opened x3 sizes
[*] Updated Salt Pickups Spawns
[*] Moved gun spawn
[*] Optimizations made to overall level
[*] Fixed bug where you would hit invisible walls around the map/doors
[*] Improvements to Monster AI Netcode/Attack *Still needs work
[*] Added Spectate System so you can fly around when you die.
[*] Added more locations for altars/matches now its 7/7 you must collect to win.
[*] Fixes to Audio not being linked to some sounds
[*] Many other various bugs, optimizations, features may have been added as well.
[*] Working tested multiplayer up to 1-5 players.
[*] Play with friends against monster ai
[*] 2 different endings
[*] 2 side objectives
[*] 2 hidden easter eggs
[*] 4 monster ais
[*] 2 playable monster types
[*] - solo, multiplayer and offline lan co-op works too.
[/list]

So while it may seem more limited, the game is more fun and enjoyable due to the nature of the simplistic design choices in this new version of unlasting horror, levels will feature different types of environments with different ai.

Please note i spent every day some days 20 full hours with no sleep to complete this new version of the game, and while sales are low and the game has been out over 2 years now, I felt this was the right decision for my community and players. I just hope you all enjoy the major changes to the game and feel as its the right direction let me know your feedback.

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28014809/ac5baaab42031091c6b22dac2ef606fa726e5001.png[/img]

The wait is over, [b]Update 109[/b] Is officially [b]public[/b].
This update has been in the works for a long time and this game is developed in community feedback so please voice your opinions on our Official [url=https://discord.gg/bAzW5f2QWd]Discord Server[/url]  and Marks for the first new update for 2022. Update 109. Please Understand I do this quite often and work on the game alot but so far has not seen any mainstream appeal or made any real funds for me to do this as a full-time living so please be respectful and understand the nature of the development that is going on for Unlasting Horror, Valve requires me to make at least $100 in sales per month to keep any earnings which I haven't gotten any yet, So Please share, purchase and continue to help small indie developers that want to make good games grow into a widely well known frequently updated Horror game for co-op, multiplayer and solo players. 

Be warned the game is only partly optimized, I am currently running on
MY PC SPECS:
1050-Ti 
I7-10700k
16GB Ram
(hopefully can do an upgrade when the game makes sales)
but as it stands i run 30 fps on Epic Settings.
